data.description:
## Goal

Surface a consistent, human-readable form for every agent-emitted ticket reference across the DSO plugin. Today, agents emit raw 16-hex UUIDs (e.g. `4ec9-cdb2-b117-4f1c`) in user-facing surfaces even when more readable identifiers — a Jira ID (`jira-dig-1647`) or a user-friendly alias (`slid-opera-cabin`) — exist for the same ticket and are already available from the CLI.

## Superseded Bug Tickets

This epic supersedes (and closes out) the following two bugs, which were clustered under a single root cause:

- **565b-25ff-4441-4882** (P3) — `[agent UX]: agents display short hex ticket IDs (e.g. 4ec9-cdb2) instead of user-friendly aliases (slid-opera-cabin) or Jira IDs (jira-dig-1647)` — the system-wide instance
- **5d6f-e4e0-2a7a-4be6** (P3) — `[brainstorm] Phase 3 displays full epic UUID instead of user-friendly alias after epic creation` — a single-skill instance

Both bugs share the same root cause and will be resolved by the same set of changes; 5d6f is a narrow story-sized instance of 565b.

## Investigation Results

Triaged 2026-05-14 during the lookup-cluster fix-bug session. Classified as `llm-behavioral` (dual-signal: ticket content describes agent output drift; affected files are skill/agent markdown). Complexity evaluator: **COMPLEX** — fix scope spans 7+ skill subsystems and 3+ distinct file types.

### Affected skill surfaces

The pattern recurs across the following skills (non-exhaustive, inventoried during triage):

- `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` — Phase 3 Step 1 (post-`ticket create` line) and Step 4 (complexity-classification log line)
- `plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md` — orchestrator summary tables and per-story messages
- `plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md` — user-facing bug summaries
- `plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md` — post-create confirmation text
- `plugins/dso/skills/end-session/SKILL.md` — session summary tables
- `plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md` — debug-cycle summaries
- `plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md` — PR comment authoring guidance

### Affected output types

- User-facing summary tables (e.g., sprint orchestrator's per-batch table)
- Commit-message templates (e.g., `Closes 7890-db5b, a93f-8ddf.`)
- PR-comment templates and bodies
- `AskUserQuestion` option labels and descriptions
- Stdout summary lines after `ticket create`

### Existing infrastructure (the cascade helper already exists)

`plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh` defines a helper `format_ticket_id` (line ~1512) that implements the preferred-form cascade:

```
auto (default): cascade jira_key → alias → short → canonical
```

Modes: `auto` (default), `canonical`, `alias`, `short`. The `ticket create` CLI command already emits both forms in its post-create line: `Created ticket sweet-garb-oryx (3c01-3b89-21f3-485a): <title>`. The gap is not in producing the formatted string — it is in callers (both Bash scripts AND skill markdown instructing the agent) consistently using it instead of the raw UUID.

## Proposed Solution

### Phase 1 — Script-side adoption (smaller, lower risk)

For every plugin script that emits ticket IDs to stdout (paths frequently consumed by the agent verbatim), route the emission through `format_ticket_id` so the output already carries the preferred form. Inventory should include `ticket-create.sh`, `ticket-list.sh`, the `--format=llm` JSON path (add a `display` key alongside `id`), and any other script-side output paths.

### Phase 2 — Skill markdown guidance (broader, lower test surface)

Update each affected skill's SKILL.md with a single shared section — e.g., `skills/shared/prompts/ticket-display-form.md` — that documents the preferred cascade (Jira > alias > short > UUID) and instructs the agent to prefer the formatted line returned by `ticket create` / `ticket show` rather than re-deriving the UUID from JSON keys. Each affected SKILL.md gets a one-line reference to the shared prompt. This is LLM-behavioral guidance, not script execution; testing is by eval/behavioral assertion rather than unit test.

### Phase 3 — Commit-message and PR-comment templates

Update the templates and helper scripts that build commit messages and PR comments to use `format_ticket_id` output where ticket references appear (e.g., `apply-attribution-trailers.sh` if it emits IDs, and any PR-comment generators in `pr-finalize-*` workflows).

### Phase 4 — AskUserQuestion options

Update orchestrator code paths that pass ticket IDs into `AskUserQuestion` option labels/descriptions to use the formatted form. This may require small helper changes in the orchestrator-side glue.

## Scope Boundary

Out of scope (resolved separately in the lookup cluster — commit d6082b385f):

- Centralized ID resolution in `ticket-lib-api.sh` (`_ticketlib_resolve_id`)
- JSON error contract on `ticket show` miss
- `ticket_read_status` hardening

Those changes ensure all subcommands ACCEPT all ID forms. This epic addresses the symmetrical concern: all output paths EMIT the preferred display form.

## Success Criteria

1. Every plugin script that emits a ticket ID to stdout uses `format_ticket_id` (or equivalent guidance) so the emitted string is already in preferred form.
2. Every affected skill SKILL.md references the shared `ticket-display-form.md` guidance.
3. Commit-message and PR-comment templates emit preferred-form IDs.
4. AskUserQuestion option text emits preferred-form IDs.
5. Behavioral eval: a sample session that creates an epic with both a Jira ID and an alias produces user-facing output that mentions the Jira ID (preferred) or alias, not the raw 16-hex UUID.

## Placeholder Status

This is a placeholder epic created to capture the cluster investigation and close out the superseded bug tickets. Full preplanning/decomposition into stories should run via `/dso:brainstorm` (or `/dso:preplanning` if the spec is considered complete) before sprint execution.
data.title: Centralize agent-emitted ticket-ID display: prefer Jira/alias over raw UUID across skills, templates, and prompts
